node.statement: If S_P is nonzero, the registered nonvanishing-delta-projection and compressed-product-display definitions say that P is nonvanishing and that S_P, with dot and dagger, is an O(e)-C*-algebra; because the H-CB datum includes the amplified corners and an extended epsilon-C*-algebra, the same O(e) constant is uniform at every matrix level n.
